author: YourAsian
body:
Hello,

 I was banned for Hacking - AntiKB, by ambi, which was appealed. In that time, while I was banned, I ban evaded on the account 'zCombo' (later known as iHumptyDumptyi). I got banned on the account 'zCombo' for "Ban Evading - CozzehPvP_". Then banned on CozzehPvP_ for "Ban Evasion - zCombo" when zCombo was banned for "Ban Evasion - CozzehPvP_". I don't know if this makes sense to you, or not but I am sorry for whatever I have done. This has confused me, yet alone confusing you, from telling you the story. I never should of hacked using Anti KB, and I'm very sorry. Please consider me, as I really want to come back to this amazing server.

title: Ban Appeal - iHumptyDumptyi (CozzehPvP_)

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello IHumptyDumptyi,

You ban evaded, we do not negotiate with ban evaders. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
